description_en: Supports structured recognition outputs of key fields, including tax authority, taxpayer identification number, taxpayer name, total amount, ticket issuer, and tax clearance details
description_zh: 支持包括税务机关、纳税人识别号、纳税人名称、合计金额、填票人、完税详单等关键字段的结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-tax-clearance-certificate --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i1/O1CN0131X3Xs1d1CHG8oypS_!!6000000003675-0-tps-1080-712.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeTaxClearanceCertificate

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).

parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
